apps.name: Focus
apps.description: Work in 25-minute sessions with a 5-minute break in between. Start, pause or skip a phase, and keep count of the sessions you finish. The count survives restarts.

apps.name: Dice
apps.description: Roll up to four six-sided dice with one tap and see the total. Tap Dice to choose how many; it remembers your choice.

apps.name: Tally
apps.description: A counter for laps, visitors, cups of coffee or anything else. Choose how much each tap adds, take one back with -1, and reset when you're done. The count survives restarts.
